title: ANZ Qantas Business Rewards: 200,000 Bonus Qantas Points with $10,000 Spend, $375 Annual Fee @ ANZ
body:
Deal: ANZ Qantas Business Rewards: 200,000 Bonus Qantas Points with $10,000 Spend, $375 Annual Fee @ ANZ

[windrc] depends what you spend it on, just exchange for gift cards is like 0.5c/p, econ flight 1c/p, business 4.5c/p
so 200k points worth 1k to 9k which will cover the cost
this is useful for finding rewards flights https://flightrewardfinder.qantas.com/
[tahayp] that's a cool site! do you know if there's a virgin equivalent?
[LostyJai] $10k, that's like 10 tanks of petrol in this economy?
[confidantduk] they aren't scammers but god damn is it a shit bank ever since the current CEO took over
[dbglt] That seems like a fabulous offer - exclusions only on two cards too, so if you haven't had an ANZ business card before should be good:
New cardholders only. Offer not available to customers who have held an ANZ Qantas Business Rewards or ANZ Business Black card in the last 12 months.
[Mass Effecta] It's a shame that the qantas rewards are a sperate buiness membership and can't link to my personal membership. Know if the points work the same?
[dbglt] You can transfer them from the business to your personal - easy, happens instantly.
[knobbs] Market seems pretty bare for consumer cards though? I am seeing more and more business card posts, but maybe that's just because no one can find consumer products to post anymore?
[Benjee] ANZ, no thanks. From my recent experience earlier this year their personal credit card team is the worst off all the major banks for card application customer service.
I am an existing ANZ customer yet they asked for so much information, asked heaps of questions then rejected my application at the final step with no explanation or logic. All this whilst telling me it would be fine through pre-approval steps and i just needed to cancel my existing credit card which i did in good faith. I was left with no credit card at all, thanks ANZ.
Fortunately the same process with another bank was quick & easy so minimsed the pain of being without a card.
[LostyJai] Credit card "serviceability" always baffle me.
You want a CC with $3k limit, no I don't think you can handle it.
Oh you meant a $1M mortgage, no problem just sign here!
[Dollar General] Mortgages are secured lending. Credit cards are unsecured lending
People will do everything they can to avoid defaulting on a mortgage. Not so with credit cards
[djmm] You should tell them you want to lodge a formal complaint
[GRP] I hope they are more sensible with business applications than they are with personal applications. I gave up on my last ANZ application as it was just too hard with constant queries whereas the card I got instead took me all of 5 minutes and was approved asap and now has hundreds of thousands spent on it.
[Moondragon] Does paying tax bills count towards the $10K spending requirement?
[windrc] I think so? someone can confirm
Taxation payments 0.5 Qantas Points per $1 spent, uncapped
https://www.anz.com.au/business/credit-cards/qantas-business…
in #3 - Eligible purchases mean purchases which are eligible to earn Qantas Points.
[Maki] So do you need a business acccount for this? Thanks
